tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Any successful bidder shall dismatle existing obstacles and materials, make use of the usable materials so that cost can be reduced.

Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of Tenders.
Tenderer Has To Upload All Qualifying Documents As Mentioned In Tender Documents And Also Should Upload Dully Filled And Signed Tender Form With Seal And Signature (Technical Part)
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed interior works as prime contractor for a value of not less than 50% i.e INR. 20.00 Lakh under Govt. or Govt. undertaking bodies during any one financial year.
GST registration certificate and PAN details of bidder
Registration certificate PWD/CPWD/MES of Class-III & above shall be attached
Must have achieved, in at least 02 financial years, a minimum financial turnover twice the value of tender i.e. Of INR 79.00 Lakh

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets or availability of credit facilities not less than 30% of the estimated value (i.e. INR 12 Lakh) in the mode of credit lines/ letter of credit/from nationalized banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.
Self-attested tender document with sign & seal on the pages of check list of Documents
The intended bidder must visit work site to understand the nature of work at his own cost & risk & must attach certificate obtained from the tender inviting authority.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: GST registration certificate and PAN No

Site visit certificate obtained from the tender inviting authority of KOMUL
Unconditional Line of Credit For amount of INR 12 Lakh from any nationalized banks.
Workdone certificate with Satisfactorily completed civil/interior works as prime contractor for INR. 20.00 Lakh under Govt. or Govt. undertaking bodies during any financial year.
